items.title: Clean tanker spot earnings slip 4.8% on the week
items.summary: Makai's week 47 report puts clean spot earnings down 4.8% w/w and 13.4% below the late-October peak. MRs led the decline as Atlantic MR earnings fell sharply while Pacific MRs held; LRs eased 2.1% and are 10–15% off peak, Handies rose on a Med/Med rebound, and the LR2 premium over Aframaxes widened past $100k/day.

items.title: MEG MR freight falls w125 as Hormuz transits slow
items.summary: Platts assessed the Middle East MR benchmark down w125 on Nov 18. Vitol placed Torm Stellar at w500 for Nov 25 diesel Duqm–East Africa and Weco Amalie went at w475 Sikka–East Africa. S&P Global counted 14 daily Hormuz transits on Nov 9 versus 32 at end-October; in Asia, Oriental Sunstone was placed at $975,000 South Korea–Japan, the first sub-$1m on that run since late August.
items.source: Hellenic Shipping News / S&P Global Platts

items.title: Stamford Shipping firms up 10 MR tankers at CIMC SOE
items.summary: Singapore's Stamford Shipping has confirmed an order for 10 MR product tankers at China's Nantong CIMC Sinopacific Offshore & Engineering. The yard has also taken two ships of the same design for an unnamed European owner; pricing and delivery dates were not disclosed.

items.title: Signal Ocean: 74% of LR2s now trading dirty
items.summary: Signal Ocean data show the dirty share of the LR2 fleet rose to 74.2% on Oct 30 from 53.0% at the start of 2025. Dirty-employed LR2s grew from 256 to 402 while clean-employed fell from 227 to 140, out of a fleet that expanded from 483 to 542 ships.

items.title: CENTCOM extends Iran blockade to ship-to-ship receivers
items.summary: A CENTCOM advisory issued Nov 18 says vessels taking cargo at sea from ships that loaded in Iran may be treated as blockade runners and can be stopped, boarded or diverted. The blockade was first imposed Apr 13, lifted in June and reimposed Jul 14; Iranian crude exports have been close to zero for months, with some LPG and jet fuel moving since July.

items.title: Capital Tankers cleared for Oslo Børs main board
items.summary: Oslo Børs confirmed on Nov 19 that it will admit the shares of Marinakis-backed Capital Tankers to its main list, about eight months after the company's Norwegian debut via a $500m equity placement.

items.title: Hormuz attacks running at about one a day in November
items.summary: Bloomberg reports UKMTO has logged roughly 14 Hormuz incidents this month, with at least two seafarers missing after this week's strikes. Kuwait has written to the IMO about attacks on eight of its tankers. Provisional Kpler data show the 7-day average of Hormuz oil transits plus STS transfers falling from about 13.4m b/d at the start of November to about 10m b/d by Nov 10.

items.title: Outbound tanker hit 6 nm north of Khasab
items.summary: UKMTO Warning 212-26 says an unidentified tanker was struck in the engine room by an unknown projectile at 1645 UTC Nov 18 while outbound through Hormuz, about 6 nm north of Khasab, Oman. All crew were reported safe; damage and the source of the projectile were not identified.

items.title: IRGC claims two supertankers hit mines in Hormuz (unverified)
items.summary: The IRGC Navy said on Nov 19 that two VLCCs carrying more than 4 million barrels combined struck mines on a 'restricted route' and were burning near the strait's southern coast. No vessel names, flags or casualty figures were given, and the claim has not been independently confirmed.

items.title: ADNOC L&S tanker attacked; 11 injured, one missing
items.summary: ADNOC Logistics & Services reported an attack on one of its vessels on the evening of Nov 17 that injured 11 crew, with one missing. Vanguard Tech identified the ship as the product tanker Navig8 Messi; ADNOC has not named it, so the identity is unconfirmed. UKMTO logged three attacks in the Gulf and off Oman in two days.

items.title: New Orleans safety zone at Mile 95.5–96.5 through Dec 11
items.summary: The Coast Guard zone, 500 ft off the east bank near the Crescent City Connection, supports salvage of the American Heritage, which capsized after a Nov 13 collision with the tanker Atlantic Asphalt. The alternate channel remains closed with limited two-way traffic through the main span; the zone may be lifted early and an initial sheen has dissipated.

items.title: LA/Long Beach security workers could strike from Nov 21
items.summary: About 250 ILWU Local 26 members, who staff six terminals handling roughly 85% of Long Beach and 33% of LA cargo per PMA, may walk out at 12:01 a.m. Saturday when their extension expires. Talks resume Friday; the coastwide dockworker contract runs to 2028.

items.title: Wall Street falls for a sixth session: S&P 500 −2.02%
items.summary: At the Nov 19 close the S&P 500 was 7,175.83 (−147.80, −2.02%), the Dow 49,097.06 (−1,101.11, −2.19%) and the Nasdaq Composite 23,879.20 (−550.69, −2.25%). Early gains reversed as talk of further Fed rate hikes and valuation concerns spread selling across nearly all sectors; energy and staples were the only sectors up, and the VIX rose 13.8% to 27.98.

items.title: Brent settles at $91.95, WTI at $83.26 after EIA builds
items.summary: On Nov 18 Brent January futures settled at $91.95 (−$1.19, −1.28%) and WTI at $83.26 (−$2.75, −3.2%), WTI's lowest close since Aug 26. EIA data for the week to Nov 13 showed crude stocks up 3.4m bbl to 417.8m bbl (poll: about +58,000) and gasoline up 5.2m bbl; Brent was little changed in Asian trade on Nov 19. OPEC+ ministers meet Nov 29 to set 2027 output.

items.title: 10-year yield near 5.05%; markets price a December hike
items.summary: The 10-year Treasury yield was about 5.05% on Nov 19, a fourth straight daily decline from one-month highs near 5.13% earlier in the week. Minutes of the Oct 27–28 FOMC meeting showed nearly all officials expected further increases, and CME FedWatch showed roughly 90% odds of a 25bp hike next month and 10% for 50bp.

items.title: Anthropic opens 34% above IPO price on Nasdaq
items.summary: Anthropic (ANT) priced its IPO at $83, opened at $111.50 on Nov 19 and closed at $97.17, up 17.1% from the offer price. Vanda Research said retail investors sold other AI names to buy the new shares; AMD fell about 7.7% after Hunterbrook disclosed a short position.

items.title: Nvidia Q3 revenue $115.8bn, guides $130bn
items.summary: Nvidia reported fiscal Q3 2027 revenue of $115.8bn, up 20% q/q and 103% y/y, with data center revenue of $107.6bn and GAAP EPS of $2.70. It guided Q4 revenue to $130.0bn ±3%, assuming no China data-center compute sales; the shares fell 3.3% on Nov 19 amid the broader sell-off.

items.title: Movers: Palo Alto +6.4%, Insmed +20.6%, UnitedHealth lower
items.summary: Palo Alto Networks gained 6.4% on Nov 19 after an earnings beat and a $4.5bn acquisition, and Insmed rose 20.6% on reports Sanofi is weighing a bid. Industrials were the weakest sector at −2.61%; gold fell about 2.1% to roughly $3,664/oz.

items.title: Trump, Xi and Putin hold first trilateral in Shenzhen
items.summary: At APEC on Nov 19 the three leaders met together for the first time; Trump and Putin also held their first talks since the 2025 Alaska summit. Reuters reports a 'peace declaration' covering UN reform, refined-fuel supply and immunity for state officials, released by Chinese state media and the Kremlin with no immediate US statement.

items.title: Gulf escalation: Riyadh tower hit, Iran targets Kuwait and Bahrain
items.summary: A Houthi missile damaged Riyadh's 385 m PIF Tower, and Iran launched drones at Kuwait's Ali Al-Salem Air Base and at Bahrain after a US strike on an Iranian missile site on Qeshm Island. Trump said he wants a lasting deal; reports that a further US-Israel strike is under consideration are unconfirmed.

items.title: ICJ rules Myanmar committed genocide against Rohingya
items.summary: The International Court of Justice found on Nov 19 that Myanmar committed genocide against the Rohingya, the first such finding by the court.

items.title: EU proposes $49.5bn 2027 loan for Ukraine
items.summary: The European Commission proposed a loan of about $49.5bn for Ukraine in 2027, repayable only once Russia pays reparations. Separately, Japan's October exports rose 20.5% on chip shipments and South Africa's inflation rose to 5.2% from 4.5%.

items.title: Denmark approves Arctic security deal with US and Greenland
items.summary: Denmark's parliament unanimously approved a trilateral agreement with the US and Greenland on Arctic security that opens the way for additional US bases.

items.title: Texans (3–6) host Colts tonight, 7:15 PM CT
items.summary: Houston, second in the AFC South behind Jacksonville (7–2), plays Indianapolis (3–7) on Thursday Night Football; the Texans' last game was a 27–24 loss at Cleveland before their bye. DE Danielle Hunter (hamstring), RB Woody Marks (concussion) and WR Marvin Harrison Jr. (hamstring) are out; the Colts are without CB Charvarius Ward and both starting tackles.

items.title: Broncos (7–2) host Raiders Sunday, 3:25 PM CT
items.summary: Denver, coming off a 26–21 win at Carolina on Nov 8 and a bye, is tied with Kansas City at 7–2 but second in the AFC West on the division-record tiebreak; Las Vegas is 4–6. On Wednesday's practice report WR Jaylen Waddle, CB Riley Moss and S Talanoa Hufanga were full participants. Game is Nov 22 on CBS.

items.title: ATP Finals: Zverev 3–0, Shelton also into semis
items.summary: On Nov 19 Zverev beat Fils 6-4 7-6(6) to finish the McEnroe Group unbeaten, and Shelton beat Jodar 7-6(8) 7-5 to finish 2–1 and reach the semifinals for the first time. Shelton meets Lendl Group winner Alcaraz on Saturday; Tiafoe plays Medvedev on Friday with the second Lendl Group spot still open.

items.title: ATP Finals: Alcaraz tops Lendl Group; Tiafoe gets first win
items.summary: On Nov 18 Alcaraz beat Medvedev to secure first place in the Lendl Group, and Tiafoe defeated Cobolli 7-6(6) 6-0. In doubles on Nov 19, Arribage/Olivetti beat top seeds Heliovaara/Patten and Arevalo/Pavic beat Luz/Matos; the event ends Sunday, Nov 22.
